itemChoicePooling.rule: Coordinator decision 2026-10-12: a printed any-N-of-M choice whose scheme marks each item the same way is ONE practice card with an anyN row (or one anyN row per marking component) listing every printed item with the scheme wording and marks, claim limit N; no Practice choice stem text. Choose-one items with multi-part marking keep mutually exclusive row routes on one card; legacy three-of-four comparisons with nested two-point groups use bestNofParts over every member.
